poin.isi: Magentic raised $18 million (Series A, led by Felicis with Sequoia) to expand AI agents that handle procurement and supply chain work at manufacturers.

Its agents work through Teams, email, and the systems companies already use: selecting suppliers, negotiating contracts, raising purchase orders, reconciling invoices. One customer processes over 1.2 million orders a year through agents.
Reported results: 2-5% savings and roughly 60% better data quality. Start with the one workflow that eats the most time, measure it, then add the next task.

headline: AI AGENTS ARE NOW DOING
REAL BUSINESS WORK
headline_caption: Magentic raised $18M for AI agents that run procurement and supply chain work for manufacturers
subjudul: No longer just answering questions: agents now handle procurement, contracts, and orders inside the systems you already use.
